infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sonaraim needs camera access to send end-to-end encrypted photos, videos, and scan pairing QR codes.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sonaraim needs microphone access for encrypted voice notes and LiveKit audio/video calls.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sonaraim needs photo library access to encrypt and share images and videos.
